title: Back to the Dictionary Form
description: See a form, find the verb: the skill you need when reading and listening.

points.title: From て / た
points.summary: Back to the dictionary form: Reading or hearing a form, find the verb you'd look up.
points.body:
- **て / た**: って ← う・つ・る, んで ← ぬ・ぶ・む, いて ← く, いで ← ぐ, して ← す; a plain て after -i / -e → る-verb (+る).
- **ない**: あ-row + ない → う-row (帰らない → 帰る, 買わない → 買う); no あ-row → る-verb (着ない → 着る).
- **ます**: い-row + ます → う-row (書きます → 書く); otherwise る-verb (見ます → 見る).
- Irregular: きて / こない → 来る, して / しない → する.

questions.hint: んで ← ぬ, ぶ or む
questions.explanation:
読んで: んで ← ぬ, ぶ or む; with this kanji only 読む makes sense → **読む**.

Example: {毎晩|まいばん}{本|ほん}を**{読|よ}んで**から{寝|ね}る。
questions.translation: Every night I read before going to sleep. (読む = to read)

questions.hint: って ← う, つ or る
questions.explanation:
買って: って ← う, つ or る; with this kanji only 買う makes sense → **買う**.

Example: パンを**{買|か}って**{帰|かえ}る。
questions.translation: I'll buy some bread on the way home. (買う = to buy)

questions.hint: って ← う, つ or る
questions.explanation:
待った: って ← う, つ or る; with this kanji only 待つ makes sense → **待つ**.

Example: {駅|えき}で30{分|ぷん}も**{待|ま}った**。
questions.translation: I waited a whole thirty minutes at the station. (待つ = to wait)

questions.hint: って ← う, つ or る
questions.explanation:
帰って: って ← う, つ or る; with this kanji only 帰る makes sense → **帰る**. ⚠ An う-verb that looks like a る-verb.

Example: {家|いえ}に**{帰|かえ}って**、すぐ{寝|ね}た。
questions.translation: I went home and went straight to bed. (帰る = to go home)

questions.hint: Try a る-verb: is there a って / んで / いて?
questions.explanation:
着て: a plain て / た after an -i / -e sound: a る-verb, so add る → **着る**.

Example: {浴衣|ゆかた}を**{着|き}て**{祭|まつ}りに{行|い}った。
questions.translation: I wore a yukata and went to the festival. (着る = to wear)

questions.hint: いて ← く
questions.explanation:
書いた: いて ← く; with this kanji only 書く makes sense → **書く**.

Example: {昨日|きのう}、{母|はは}に{手紙|てがみ}を**{書|か}いた**。
questions.translation: I wrote a letter to my mother yesterday. (書く = to write)

questions.hint: いで ← ぐ
questions.explanation:
急いで: いで ← ぐ; with this kanji only 急ぐ makes sense → **急ぐ**.

Example: **{急|いそ}いで**{駅|えき}まで{走|はし}った。
questions.translation: I hurried to the station. (急ぐ = to hurry)

questions.hint: して ← す
questions.explanation:
話した: して ← す; with this kanji only 話す makes sense → **話す**.

Example: {先生|せんせい}と{将来|しょうらい}について**{話|はな}した**。
questions.translation: I talked with my teacher about the future. (話す = to speak)

questions.hint: んで ← ぬ, ぶ or む
questions.explanation:
遊んだ: んで ← ぬ, ぶ or む; with this kanji only 遊ぶ makes sense → **遊ぶ**.

Example: {公園|こうえん}で{子供|こども}と**{遊|あそ}んだ**。
questions.translation: I played with the kids in the park. (遊ぶ = to play)

questions.hint: って ← う, つ, る … or the exception 行く
questions.explanation:
行って: 行って is the one irregular て-form: 行く → **行く**.

Example: {駅|えき}まで**{行|い}って**、{電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}った。
questions.translation: I went to the station and got on the train. (行く = to go)

questions.hint: Irregular: き・こ・く
questions.explanation:
来て: き / こ belong to the irregular 来る (きます, こない, きて) → **来る**.

Example: {明日|あした}も**{来|き}て**ください。
questions.translation: Please come tomorrow too. (来る = to come)

questions.hint: ら is an あ-row sound
questions.explanation:
帰らない: ら (あ-row) + ない → back to the う-row: ら → る → **帰る**. ⚠ An う-verb that looks like a る-verb.

Example: {今夜|こんや}は{家|いえ}に**{帰|かえ}らない**。
questions.translation: I'm not going home tonight. (帰る = to go home)

questions.hint: No あ-row sound before ない
questions.explanation:
着ない: nothing but ない was added, so it's a る-verb: ない → る → **着る**.

Example: {夏|なつ}はコートを**{着|き}ない**。
questions.translation: I don't wear a coat in summer. (着る = to wear)

questions.hint: ら is an あ-row sound
questions.explanation:
知らない: ら (あ-row) + ない → back to the う-row: ら → る → **知る**. ⚠ An う-verb that looks like a る-verb.

Example: その{話|はなし}は**{知|し}らない**。
questions.translation: I don't know that story. (知る = to know)

questions.hint: わ is an あ-row sound
questions.explanation:
買わない: わ (あ-row) + ない → back to the う-row: わ → う → **買う**.

Example: {高|たか}いから**{買|か}わない**。
questions.translation: It's expensive, so I won't buy it. (買う = to buy)

questions.hint: Irregular: き・こ・く
questions.explanation:
来ない: き / こ belong to the irregular 来る (きます, こない, きて) → **来る**.

Example: バスがなかなか**{来|こ}ない**。
questions.translation: The bus just isn't coming. (来る = to come)

questions.hint: -i sound before ます: る-verb (+る) or う-verb (i → u)?
questions.explanation:
見ます: an -i sound before ます can be a る-verb (+る) or an う-verb (い-row → う-row). You have to know the verb: here it's a る-verb, not 見む → **見る**.

Example: {毎晩|まいばん}ニュースを**{見|み}ます**。
questions.translation: I watch the news every evening. (見る = to see)

questions.hint: -i sound before ます: る-verb (+る) or う-verb (i → u)?
questions.explanation:
書きます: an -i sound before ます can be a る-verb (+る) or an う-verb (い-row → う-row). You have to know the verb: here it's an う-verb, not 書きる → **書く**.

Example: {毎日|まいにち}{日記|にっき}を**{書|か}きます**。
questions.translation: I write in my diary every day. (書く = to write)

questions.hint: -i sound before ます: る-verb (+る) or う-verb (i → u)?
questions.explanation:
借ります: an -i sound before ます can be a る-verb (+る) or an う-verb (い-row → う-row). You have to know the verb: here it's a る-verb, not 借る → **借りる**.

Example: {図書館|としょかん}で{本|ほん}を**{借|か}ります**。
questions.translation: I borrow books from the library. (借りる = to borrow)

questions.hint: -i sound before ます: る-verb (+る) or う-verb (i → u)?
questions.explanation:
入ります: an -i sound before ます can be a る-verb (+る) or an う-verb (い-row → う-row). You have to know the verb: here it's an う-verb, not 入りる → **入る**. ⚠ An う-verb that looks like a る-verb.

Example: {毎晩|まいばん}お{風呂|ふろ}に**{入|はい}ります**。
questions.translation: I take a bath every evening. (入る = to enter)
